profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that trades under the ticker XPEV. Its Spanish site, XPENG España, presents the brand's fully electric range under the slogan "Xpande tu mundo" and states that the company has been turning what the world calls the future into reality since 2014. The models described on the site are the G6, G9 and P7⁺.

The company describes those three models as combining artificial intelligence and advanced driver assistance systems with the SEPA 2.0 800-volt electric platform, which it says allows charging from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. All three models are said to carry the DGT CERO label and a warranty of up to 7 years or 160,000 km. The site also states that the party responsible for handling data submitted through its contact form is CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U., and that the financing offers listed on the page are provided by Open Bank, S.A.

The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001810997 and is also listed as XPENG INC - ADR. No lawsuits involving the company are on record.
